## POST `/api/instances/supportProxy/{id}/action/modify`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Modify support proxy settings. Enable, disable or change support proxy options.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Unique identifier of the support proxy instance. --eng This value is always 0, because at any given time there is only one proxy. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `isEnabled` | boolean | Configure the use of a proxy server. Values are: true - Uses a proxy server false - Does not use a proxy server |
| `protocol` | `ProxyProtocolEnum` | Proxy server protocols. \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|Http\|0\|Support proxy protocol is http.\| \|Socks\|1\|Support proxy protocol is socks.\| |
| `address` | string (IPv6 supported: true, Prefix-length supported: false, Port supported: true, DNS name supported: true) | Address of proxy server. If a port is not specified the following default ports will be used: Protocol = http, Default port = 3128 Protocol = socks, Default port = 1080 |
| `username` | string | User account with permission to access the proxy server. |
| `password` | string | User account password for the proxy server. |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
